title: AMNESIA
synopsis:
This story takes place in a fictional town, in a fictional country, in a fictional world. One morning, a young lady awakens to find that she has lost all her memories prior to that morning. Her life, her relationships, her very name—all gone. All that's left is a cell phone with numbers and names she doesn't recognize and Orion, a young boy that only she appears to be able to see. With Orion's guidance, she struggles to make sense of herself, a boyfriend she doesn't know and the thousand and one little things that make up a daily life. But with no memories left, the only alternative is to forge new ones, even if that means leaving old loves behind.

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

episodes.title: I
episodes.synopsis: When our heroine awakes, she has no recollection of who she is or from whence she came. With the help of a spirit named Orion, she begins piecing together her life.

episodes.title: II
episodes.synopsis: No one knows our heroine has lost her memories. Going about her daily routine, she suddenly remembers a conversation she had with Shin. The topic of conversation? Murder.

episodes.title: III
episodes.synopsis: In order to refresh our heroine's memory, Shin reveals more about their relationship.

episodes.title: IV
episodes.synopsis: We finally learn the truth about our heroine's accident.

episodes.title: V
episodes.synopsis: Our Heroine tries to figure out why she was sent back in time.

episodes.title: VI
episodes.synopsis: Our Heroine can't decipher which of Ikki's personality is the real one. Later, someone advises her to be looking over her shoulder.

episodes.title: VII
episodes.synopsis: Heroine converses with Kent and tries to pretend that she is following, but she is fooling no one...least of all Kent.

episodes.title: VIII
episodes.synopsis: Toma cares for our Heroine when she faints; the pair later go shopping, and it isn't long before our Heroine is approached by a trio of angry girls.

episodes.title: IX
episodes.synopsis: Our heroine makes it home, and she is alarmed by what she reads in her diary.

episodes.title: X
episodes.synopsis: Our heroine finally makes it home. She reads her diary and uncovers a new truth.

episodes.title: XI
episodes.synopsis: Poor Heroine's days keep getting stranger and stranger... Ukyo's split personalities either want to help her or hurt her, and it could mean danger.

episodes.title: XII
episodes.synopsis: Ukyo's evil persona has his sights set on killing our Heroine. Ukyo finally catches up with our Heroine at a bell tower, where she has gone to escape him. Time has run out for one of them...
